items.title: Why Lululemon (LULU) Shares Are Getting Obliterated Today
items.summary: Shares of athletic apparel retailer Lululemon (NASDAQ:LULU) fell 17.7% in the afternoon session after the company reported a decline in second-quarter net revenue and slashed its full-year sales and profit guidance. According to the company's press release, Lululemon reported net revenue of $2.42 billion, down 4.3% year-over-year, alongside a 9% decline in total comparable sales. items.title: LULU Q2 Deep Dive: Brand Sentiment and Product Pressures Drive Revenue Decline and Lower Outlook
items.summary: Athletic apparel retailer Lululemon (NASDAQ:LULU) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales falling 4.3% year on year to $2.42 billion. Next quarter’s revenue guidance of $2.31 billion underwhelmed, coming in 8.8% below analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $2.92 per share was 63.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
